leads.title: Waterborne spread of cholera shown in London
leads.why: Mapping deaths and comparing the customers of rival water companies tied cholera to sewage in water and gave epidemiology its method.
leads.verify: Snow's 1849 essay, the 1854 Broad Street inquiry and the 1855 comparison of water companies; how his contemporaries received it; William Budd's parallel work on typhoid; Pacini's 1854 sighting of the vibrio.

leads.title: Mosquito transmission of yellow fever in Havana
leads.why: Naming one mosquito as the carrier let Havana and then Panama be cleared of yellow fever by attacking its breeding places.
leads.verify: Carlos Finlay's 1881 paper and his experiments; the 1900 United States Army commission's proof; Gorgas's control campaigns of 1901 onward; whether Finlay knew Manson's 1877 work on filaria in mosquitoes.

leads.title: Mosquito transmission of malaria in India
leads.why: Finding the malaria parasite's cycle in mosquitoes turned the control of the deadliest tropical disease toward nets, drainage and insecticides.
leads.verify: Ross's 1897 observation and 1898 proof of the cycle in birds; Grassi's 1898 demonstration in humans in Rome; the debt to Manson (filaria, Amoy, 1877) and to Laveran's parasite (1880); Smith and Kilborne's tick work of 1893 as the first proved arthropod transmission.

leads.title: Proof that smoking causes lung cancer
leads.where: London, England, and St Louis, United States
leads.why: Case-control and cohort studies fixed the cause of the century's commonest fatal cancer, and smoking fell in many countries as a result.
leads.verify: The 1950 papers of Doll and Hill and of Wynder and Graham and the 1954 British doctors study; the German studies of 1939 and 1943 that came first; the 1962 and 1964 official reports that turned evidence into policy.

leads.title: Coca chewing in the Andes
leads.why: Coca with lime sustained work at altitude across the Andes for eight thousand years, and cocaine isolated from it gave medicine local anaesthesia in 1884.
leads.verify: The dated finds of chewed coca leaves and burnt lime in the Nanchoc valley; evidence for cultivation; the chain from coca to isolated cocaine (1860) and Koller's local anaesthesia (1884).

leads.title: Isolation of morphine from opium
leads.why: The first pure plant alkaloid showed that a remedy's power lay in one measurable substance, and quinine, atropine, codeine and exact dosing followed.
leads.verify: The dates of Serturner's isolation and of his 1806 and 1817 papers; rival claims (Derosne, Seguin); the start of commercial production by Merck in 1827.
